=== KOMANDA 1 (ustanovka, ~3-5 min, zhdat INSTALL_DONE) ===
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hacho88/stroiapp.ru/master/deploy/install.sh -o /root/install.sh && bash /root/install.sh && echo INSTALL_DONE

=== KOMANDA 2 (.env + restart + proverka, zhdat DEPLOY_OK) ===
echo '' | base64 -d > /var/www/ai-manager/repo/backend/.env && chown www-data:www-data /var/www/ai-manager/repo/backend/.env && systemctl restart ai-manager && sleep 3 && systemctl is-active ai-manager && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/health && echo && echo DEPLOY_OK
